decision_log.rationale:
The pipeline was aborted after exhausting all 3 replan attempts at the Ingestor stage. Here is a full summary of what occurred:

**Ingestor Run 1 (initial):** 47,830 raw shots ingested; only 16,830 accepted. Shot density peaked at 1.73 shots/km² — below the minimum acceptable threshold. Root cause: 64.7% of raw shots (30,943) carry quality_flag=0 and are unconditionally rejected. Recommended action: replan_widen_date.

**Replan 1 — Widen Date (+90 days):** Date window extended to 2023-07-30. Re-ran ingestor — same result: 16,887 accepted shots, density still at 1.73 shots/km². The additional date range yielded no new quality_flag=1 shots. The structural bottleneck remained unchanged.

**Replan 2 — Relax Thresholds:** sensitivity_min reduced by 0.05 and slope_max_deg raised to 35°. Re-ran ingestor — still 16,830 accepted shots, density unchanged at 1.73 shots/km². As the ingestor had warned, threshold relaxation yields only ~57 additional shots (+0.3%), confirming the quality_flag filter is the binding constraint, not sensitivity or slope.

**Conclusion:** The AOI has fundamentally insufficient high-quality GEDI coverage. With 64.7% of shots permanently flagged as poor quality, no combination of parameter adjustments can raise shot density above 1.73 shots/km². The Transformer and QA stages were never reached. The pipeline cannot proceed without a different AOI, a future GEDI overpass cycle, or a different data source.
